description: Macro site design for the integration of the new 1,500 x 1,500 Combined Complex world with the existing vanilla-384 bot world at (935, 60, 300). Adds the old town (30-35 schematics in 7 clusters), the Gateway station (two matching 7x7 pavilions), the Grand Avenue (425 blocks, 8 cross-section), the coastal-plain rail spur (960 blocks, 3 cross-section, 3 stations), the underground easter egg (the only existing underground schematic in the workspace), and the visitor journey (60-90 minutes of focused play). Respects all 7 binding decisions in discussion-notes.md.

scale.notes: 1:1 globally per discussion-notes Decision 1. New world requires 1,024+ build height (CubicWorld 2,048 recommended). Existing world is vanilla 384, preserved as-is.

recommended_mod_new_world: CubicWorld or similar with at least 2,048 block build height

binding_decisions_respected.binding_decision: Build a new 1,500 x 1,500 world with 1,024+ build height, world origin (0, 0, 0). The existing vanilla-384 bot world is preserved; the two are connected by a Gateway portal.
binding_decisions_respected.site_plan_reflection: Reflected in world_footprint, world_origin, and the gateway_portal inter-world connection. The existing world is preserved as-is; the new world is built fresh; the Gateway portal at (935, 60, 280) and (0, 0, 700) is the only piece of architecture that connects them.

binding_decisions_respected.binding_decision: 7 clusters, 30-35 schematics in a 600 x 400 coastal-plain district centered at (0, 0, 500). 13 residential, 3 castle/fortress, 3 temple, 10 statue/ornament (4 in cluster + 6 along Grand Avenue), 1 theme-park (Space Mountain), 1 underground easter egg, 2 Cute house anchors (folded into residential). Excluded: Pokemon Temple Arena (deferred), watercraft, beach content, holiday-express-train.
binding_decisions_respected.site_plan_reflection: Reflected in old_town_clusters (33 schematics total) and old_town_bounding_box (X = -300 to +300, Z = 300 to 700, Y = -3 to +6). All 7 clusters have specific coordinates and sign specifications.

binding_decisions_respected.binding_decision: Two matching pavilions: existing-world 7 x 7 stone-brick pavilion at (935, 60, 280) with glass roof; new-world 7 x 7 wooden shelter at (0, 0, 700). Both have a 4 x 5 obsidian portal frame, a sign, a written book. The portal is visual; the transit is a /tp command block. 2 new markers.
binding_decisions_respected.site_plan_reflection: Reflected in gateway_pavilion_existing_world, gateway_shelter_new_world, and gateway_portal. Both pavilions are 7 x 7 with matching 4 x 5 obsidian frames. The /tp mechanism is flagged as an open question for the bot team.

binding_decisions_respected.binding_decision: Straight, 425 blocks, 8-block cross-section (4-block road + 2-block sidewalk each side, no planters). Stone brick for blocks 0-350, granite-and-glass for 350-425. 6 statues at 70-block intervals, 3 milestones, 1 stream crossing (5-block arch at block 380). 1 new marker, 1 new named route.
binding_decisions_respected.site_plan_reflection: Reflected in grand_avenue_start, grand_avenue_end, grand_avenue_milestone_1/2/3, grand_avenue_stream_crossing, and the 6 statue coordinates (teddy-bear at 70, macaw at 140, parrot at 210, eagle at 280, villager at 350, enderman at 420). Cross-section 8 blocks total, no planters.

binding_decisions_respected.binding_decision: Passenger minecart, 1-block-gauge, 3-block cross-section (1 rail + 1 walkway + 1 utility strip), smooth stone slabs, powered rail every 8 blocks. 960 blocks, 3 named stations (new world Gateway, old town, city approach). Bypasses old town on east side with a spur. 1 new route, 3 new station markers, supply chain, squad.
binding_decisions_respected.site_plan_reflection: Reflected in rail_spur_new_world_gateway_station, rail_spur_old_town_station, rail_spur_city_approach_station, and rail_spur_main_line_bypass. Cross-section 3 blocks (1 rail + 1 oak-plank walkway east + 1 grass/utility strip west). Material smooth stone slabs. Powered rail every 8 blocks. Bypass at X = +50.

binding_decisions_respected.binding_decision: One, only one. underground-base.schem placed at (-50, 0, 550), partially buried, with a historical sign, a 1-block entrance at the back of a residential house, an interior chest with a written book, and a 1 x 1 glass viewing window in the old town central plaza. Pre-build: schematic must be inspected for compatibility. 1 new marker.
binding_decisions_respected.site_plan_reflection: Reflected in underground_easter_egg_schematic_placement (Y = -3 to +2), underground_easter_egg_entrance, underground_easter_egg_glass_window, and mkr_old_town_underground_easter_egg. Pre-build inspection flagged as an open question for the design team.

binding_decisions_respected.binding_decision: Default spawn: new world Gateway at (0, 0, 700). One-way descent 60-90 minutes through 6 named markers. Single return portal at the Cheyenne outer portal (visual, /tp to existing-world Gateway). Fast travel to 6 markers available only after the first descent. 1 new named route, 1 new return portal marker.
binding_decisions_respected.site_plan_reflection: Reflected in named_markers_combined_complex_journey (6 fast-travel destinations) and mkr_cheyenne_return_portal (the return portal at (0, 0, -420)). Default spawn is the new world Gateway; existing world is a secondary visit. Fast travel only after the first descent.

open_questions_for_architectural_designe: World-transit mechanism: /tp command block or world-portal datapack? (bot team call)
Schematic inspector for underground-base.schem: does the design team need to build one?
Legacy block ID risk: is there a sandbox world available, or should the design team create one?
New world's spawn point: superflat or default world type? (map integration is agnostic)
Existing world's relationship to the new world: should the 4 active bots migrate? (map integration default: stay in existing world)
Existing-world return path: returnable lobby, one-way vestibule, or bidirectional with side effects? (map integration default: returnable lobby)
Old town era discipline: how to handle the Space Mountain's 58 KB native scale vs. the 2-floor height cap? (clip, frame with hedges, or relax cap)
Data layer creation: should the design team create routes.json and supply_chains.json file shells?
tension_acknowledged: The culture-architecture-analysis.md describes the Grand Avenue as 4-block-wide with 1-block sidewalks and 1-block planters (total ~8 blocks), but the binding Decision 4 specifies the cross-section as 8 blocks total (4 road + 2 sidewalk each side, no planters). The binding Decision 4 takes precedence - the Grand Avenue is 8 blocks total, with no planters. The architectural designer should not add planters.
